Go Beyond PCR

# **Enabling AI-driven precision medicine at scale with faster, lower-cost, higher-plex multiomics**

### [Product][25]

##### [Discover more about RAPTOR, our groundbreaking new Hypercoding instrument platform.][26]

### [Technology][27]

##### [Learn more about how Hypercoding works and why it has the potential to revolutionize
##### genomics.][28]

### [Applications][29]

##### [Find out about all of the many ways RAPTOR can impact your specific lab workflow and
##### economics.][30]

Genomic testing has changed how healthcare is delivered, but while there are ~2 million new cases of
cancer diagnosed in the US each year, only a small fraction of those are tested due to the cost,
complexity, and lengthy workflows of existing platforms. At Pleno, we reimagined how genomic testing
could be done and have built an instrument platform from the ground up to unlock the vast market
potential of clinical genomics.

This holds true for more than just oncology. In fact, for all applications where genomics has been
shown to improve the quality of care, penetration has been limited, leaving large, untapped markets.

While Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) ushered in a new era of personalized medicine, unlocking the
genome to drive improved outcomes, the costs have remained prohibitive. Even though sequencing costs
continue to decline, the challenge remains that sequencing costs are only a fraction of the total
cost associated with going from a patient sample to a recommended therapy. Total cost, turnaround
time, and workflow are all critical to drive uptake. Other enabling tools like PCR and Microarrays
face similar challenges that limit their growth potential and market penetration.

Innovators and Inventors
Join Us

Be part of the driving force behind our innovation and impact. We are building great things and we
need your talent.

We’re innovators and inventors, collaborators and problem solvers – a multidisciplinary team of
scientists, engineers and technologists. We take on challenges with enthusiasm and passion. The
innovations we create together will have meaningful impact in far-reaching ways. 

We invite you to look at our open positions. If you don’t see one that’s a match for your skills and
experience, let us know you’re interested in joining our team in future and we can match you with
any new openings.

### Accelerate Your Career

Send us your resume and tell us more about why you think you would be a good fit for our team at
Pleno.

[ Send Now ][31]

### Open Positions

Browse through the open positions we have available in a variety of roles across our company.

[ Learn More ][32]

Go Beyond PCR

# **Enabling AI-driven precision medicine at scale with faster, lower-cost, higher-plex multiomics**

### [Product][25]

##### [Discover more about RAPTOR, our groundbreaking new Hypercoding instrument platform.][26]

### [Technology][27]

##### [Learn more about how Hypercoding works and why it has the potential to revolutionize
##### genomics.][28]

### [Applications][29]

##### [Find out about all of the many ways RAPTOR can impact your specific lab workflow and
##### economics.][30]

Genomic testing has changed how healthcare is delivered, but while there are ~2 million new cases of
cancer diagnosed in the US each year, only a small fraction of those are tested due to the cost,
complexity, and lengthy workflows of existing platforms. At Pleno, we reimagined how genomic testing
could be done and have built an instrument platform from the ground up to unlock the vast market
potential of clinical genomics.

This holds true for more than just oncology. In fact, for all applications where genomics has been
shown to improve the quality of care, penetration has been limited, leaving large, untapped markets.

While Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) ushered in a new era of personalized medicine, unlocking the
genome to drive improved outcomes, the costs have remained prohibitive. Even though sequencing costs
continue to decline, the challenge remains that sequencing costs are only a fraction of the total
cost associated with going from a patient sample to a recommended therapy. Total cost, turnaround
time, and workflow are all critical to drive uptake. Other enabling tools like PCR and Microarrays
face similar challenges that limit their growth potential and market penetration.

Innovators and Inventors
Join Us

Be part of the driving force behind our innovation and impact. We are building great things and we
need your talent.

We’re innovators and inventors, collaborators and problem solvers – a multidisciplinary team of
scientists, engineers and technologists. We take on challenges with enthusiasm and passion. The
innovations we create together will have meaningful impact in far-reaching ways. 

We invite you to look at our open positions. If you don’t see one that’s a match for your skills and
experience, let us know you’re interested in joining our team in future and we can match you with
any new openings.

### Accelerate Your Career

Send us your resume and tell us more about why you think you would be a good fit for our team at
Pleno.

[ Send Now ][31]

### Open Positions

Browse through the open positions we have available in a variety of roles across our company.

[ Learn More ][32]

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

# Pythia BioSciences
# Multi-Omics Analysis Software and Services

Accelerating discoveries in life sciences with high-quality curated omics data, intelligent
analytics platforms and cutting-edge services.

[Explore our platform][28]
[See our curated data][29]

### "The utility of Pythia’s C-DIAM to deliver complex multi-omics projects from a bioinformatics
### team to biology end users is extremely valuable."

- Top 10 Pharma -

## Multiple Omics.
## One Single Platform.

C-DIAM Multi-Omics Studio is a web platform that supports scientists to analyze and integrate
multi-omics data,  through which they can reveal a full picture about biology. C-DIAM owns a
microservice-based architecture that enables speedy customizations, along with a graphical user
interface accessible to all biologists.


Tackle top challenges in multiomics analysis:
* Conduct multi-omics experiments with an Intuitive Graphical Interface
* Tear down the data silos 
* Keep up with the latest data types, datasets and knowledge models
* Integrate with public, third party and private databases and software tools. 
* Unite scientists with their  colleagues in Bioinformatics, Datascience and Cheminformatics. 
* Share data, results and entire projects

[Explore C-DIAM ][30]

### Integration and customization 

Microservice based cloud architecture enables rapid deployment, integration and customization.
*  Integration with public, third party and private data sources, pipelines and applications, like R
  shiny data visualization dashboards.   

### Next Generation pathway and interactome knowledgebase 

Multiple pathway and interactome knowledge sources and workflows,  including Pythia's  
Intercellular Signaling Prediction.  

### Unified Multi-Omics Data management and  Analysis 

Easily explore the various types of omics data as individual datasets and as integrated analysis
workflows that can be customized for optimal performance. 

### Adjustable Target & Biomarker  workflows

Choose common workflow templates and customize your own.  Additionally,  Tox, MOA and PD biomarker
workflows are in development and  coming soon.

## Let Multi-Omics Data Take Your Research to Higher Grounds

Skip the hassles of data finding, cleaning and standardizing with Pythiomics, our meticulously
curated omics database for drug research. Pythiomics combines rigorous quality control, metadata
harmonization and documentation - creating a standardized and reliable data resource for
biopharmaceutical companies and research institutions to accelerate data analysis, data integration,
and data-driven drug discovery.

[Explore Pythiomics ][31]

## About Us

Every Scientist is Important Because Every Patient is Important

[We work hard to understand our pharmaceutical customer's challenges and offer optimal solutions to
address their critical needs. Pythia Biosciences is uniquely positioned to address the needs of our
customers by combining our software and content offerings along with a wide array of complementary
services. ][32]

Scientist-Led Multiomics Excellence

Signios Bio combines advanced technical infrastructure with deep biological expertise to redefine
multi-omic research. Operating out of our state-of-the-art Foster City lab, our PhD-level scientists
oversee every touchpoint of the process, ensuring rigorous quality control from the first library
preparation to the final bioinformatics report. This hands-on, scientist-to-scientist collaboration
guarantees that your data is not only accurate but truly actionable for translational research and
early-stage drug discovery.

#### Scientist-Led Study Design

PhD scientists guide experimental design, service selection, and biological interpretation—ensuring
every study produces meaningful insights.

#### Multi-Omics Platform Expertise

Validated workflows across 10x Genomics, Olink, Twist, Illumina, and PacBio, enable the right
technology for every research questions.

#### In-House Laboratory Execution

All sequencing services run in our Foster City laboratory, ensuring full quality control,
operational consistency, and fast delivery timelines.

#### Unified Data-to-Insight Workflow

Sequencing and bioinformatics teams operate within integrated workflows—from sample processing to
biological interpretation.

#### Integrated Bioinformatics

Automated pipelines transform raw sequencing data into structured, biologically relevant insights
aligned with your study objectives.

Advancing Research Across Therapeutic Areas

Signios Bio serves as an expert extension of your research team, helping navigate the complexities
of modern disease biology. By uniting diverse multi-omic technologies—including bulk sequencing,
single-cell analysis, spatial transcriptomics, and proteomics—under one roof, we provide the
high-resolution data required to drive innovation. Our scientist-led workflows empower translational
research and biomarker discovery teams to transform molecular insights into the next generation of
precision therapies.

Oncology

From decoding complex [tumor genomics][105] to characterizing [immune infiltration][106], our
multi-omic workflows answer the toughest questions in cancer biology. We provide deep insights into
the pathways driving progression, helping researchers validate targets and accelerate the
development of precision therapies.

Immunology

From [TCR/BCR sequencing][107] to single-cell profiling, we provide a holistic view of the immune
landscape. Our multi-omic approach enables researchers to dissect immune activation and exhaustion,
uncovering the biomarkers and mechanisms behind autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

Rare Diseases

Identify the molecular drivers of undiagnosed conditions with high-resolution [Whole Genome and
Exome Sequencing][108]. We provide the deep genomic coverage required to uncover novel mutations and
clarify the genetic basis of rare disorders, helping researchers accelerate the path to diagnosis
and therapeutic development.

Neurology Disorders

Map the molecular architecture of the brain with [spatial biology][109] and [single-cell
sequencing][110]. We help researchers decode the cellular heterogeneity of neurodegenerative
disorders, identifying the localized biomarkers and therapeutic targets necessary to understand
disease progression and neuroinflammation.

Metabolic & Cardiovascular Disorders

Identify the molecular drivers of metabolic and cardiovascular disease through high-sensitivity
[proteomics][111] and [genomic profiling][112]. Our validated workflows help researchers uncover
critical biomarkers for insulin resistance, obesity, and atherosclerosis, providing the foundational
insights required to advance precision therapies for metabolic health.

Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT)

Optimize the development of advanced therapeutics with high-resolution molecular characterization.
Our [single-cell][113] and [long-read sequencing][114] services enable precise monitoring of gene
editing outcomes, CAR-T cell persistence, and vector integration, providing the essential data
needed to ensure the safety and efficacy of next-generation biologics.

[ Talk to Our Team ][115]

Certified Platform Expertise

Signios Bio is a scientist-led **NGS and proteomics service provider** dedicated to experimental
rigor and molecular insight. From initial study design to advanced bioinformatics, our PhD-level
experts ensure every project is optimized for high-quality data delivery.

As a Certified Service Provider for [10x Genomics][116], [Takara][117], [Olink][118],

our Foster City, CA (SF Bay Area) laboratory. Our validated protocols and quality-controlled

Scientist-Led Multiomics Excellence

Signios Bio combines advanced technical infrastructure with deep biological expertise to redefine
multi-omic research. Operating out of our state-of-the-art Foster City lab, our PhD-level scientists
oversee every touchpoint of the process, ensuring rigorous quality control from the first library
preparation to the final bioinformatics report. This hands-on, scientist-to-scientist collaboration
guarantees that your data is not only accurate but truly actionable for translational research and
early-stage drug discovery.

#### Scientist-Led Study Design

PhD scientists guide experimental design, service selection, and biological interpretation—ensuring
every study produces meaningful insights.

#### Multi-Omics Platform Expertise

Validated workflows across 10x Genomics, Olink, Twist, Illumina, and PacBio, enable the right

All sequencing services run in our Foster City laboratory, ensuring full quality control,
operational consistency, and fast delivery timelines.

Sequencing and bioinformatics teams operate within integrated workflows—from sample processing to
biological interpretation.

#### Integrated Bioinformatics

Automated pipelines transform raw sequencing data into structured, biologically relevant insights
aligned with your study objectives.

Advancing Research Across Therapeutic Areas

Signios Bio serves as an expert extension of your research team, helping navigate the complexities
of modern disease biology. By uniting diverse multi-omic technologies—including bulk sequencing,
single-cell analysis, spatial transcriptomics, and proteomics—under one roof, we provide the
high-resolution data required to drive innovation. Our scientist-led workflows empower translational
research and biomarker discovery teams to transform molecular insights into the next generation of
precision therapies.

From decoding complex [tumor genomics][105] to characterizing [immune infiltration][106], our
multi-omic workflows answer the toughest questions in cancer biology. We provide deep insights into
the pathways driving progression, helping researchers validate targets and accelerate the
development of precision therapies.

Immunology

From [TCR/BCR sequencing][107] to single-cell profiling, we provide a holistic view of the immune
landscape. Our multi-omic approach enables researchers to dissect immune activation and exhaustion,
uncovering the biomarkers and mechanisms behind autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

Rare Diseases

Identify the molecular drivers of undiagnosed conditions with high-resolution [Whole Genome and
Exome Sequencing][108]. We provide the deep genomic coverage required to uncover novel mutations and
clarify the genetic basis of rare disorders, helping researchers accelerate the path to diagnosis
and therapeutic development.

Neurology Disorders

Map the molecular architecture of the brain with [spatial biology][109] and [single-cell
sequencing][110]. We help researchers decode the cellular heterogeneity of neurodegenerative
disorders, identifying the localized biomarkers and therapeutic targets necessary to understand
disease progression and neuroinflammation.

Metabolic & Cardiovascular Disorders

Identify the molecular drivers of metabolic and cardiovascular disease through high-sensitivity
[proteomics][111] and [genomic profiling][112]. Our validated workflows help researchers uncover
critical biomarkers for insulin resistance, obesity, and atherosclerosis, providing the foundational
insights required to advance precision therapies for metabolic health.

Optimize the development of advanced therapeutics with high-resolution molecular characterization.
Our [single-cell][113] and [long-read sequencing][114] services enable precise monitoring of gene
editing outcomes, CAR-T cell persistence, and vector integration, providing the essential data
needed to ensure the safety and efficacy of next-generation biologics.

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of

история создания, достижения, цифры
**В конце июня 2025 года** был дан «Старт» новому направлению в переработке **– запущен в
эксплуатацию Завод технических фабрикатов.** Это завод по переработке боенских отходов. На сегодня
произведены пуско-наладочные работы, произведена работа по отладке технологических процессов нового
производства.
Созданные производственные номинальные мощности ЗТФ:
**Цель создания ЗТФ** – обеспечение биобезопасности производств АПХ, самостоятельная переработка
боенских отходов, образующихся на предприятиях АПХ "Дороничи".

Линия по приёму пера 9 тонн/сутки, производство 2,7 тонн перьевой муки/сутки;
Две линии по приёму крови суммарно 8,8 тонн/сутки, и производству 0,7 тонн кровяной муки/сутки;
Суммарно производственная номинальная мощность ЗТФ = 73,7 тонн сырья в сутки или 19,9 тонны ГП в
сутки, **23 000 тонн сырья /год**.
Линия по приёму боенских отходов курицы 21,5 тонн/сутки, производство 3,6 тонн куриной муки/сутки и
2,2 тонн куриного жира/сутки;
Линия по приёму боенских отходов свинины 34,4 тонн/сутки, производство 6,7 тонн свиной муки/сутки и

**В конце июня 2025 года** был дан «Старт» новому направлению в переработке **– запущен в

Две линии по приёму крови суммарно 8,8 тонн/сутки, и производству 0,7 тонн кровяной муки/сутки;
Суммарно производственная номинальная мощность ЗТФ = 73,7 тонн сырья в сутки или 19,9 тонны ГП в
сутки, **23 000 тонн сырья /год**.
Линия по приёму боенских отходов курицы 21,5 тонн/сутки, производство 3,6 тонн куриной муки/сутки и
2,2 тонн куриного жира/сутки;
Линия по приёму боенских отходов свинины 34,4 тонн/сутки, производство 6,7 тонн свиной муки/сутки и
4 тонны свиного жира/сутки;

# **Find Talent or Find a Job with Zenopa**

 

Zenopa recruits for roles across the US, EU and UK. With over three decades of experience in
healthcare recruitment, we lead the way in sourcing the most technically and culturally aligned
talent for your business, supporting in accelerating your organisational success.

 

Our consultants pride themselves in being specialists, gaining fresh insights to expand their niche
market knowledge daily and sharing this with you, so you can make data-driven decisions.

 

If your recruiting in the Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, Dental, Animal Health,
Chemistry, Physics or Service Engineering markets, reach out to a member of the team to start your
talent search today.
